eventText: Your manager pulls you aside. There's a senior role opening and your name has come up.

success.outcomeText: You got the promotion. $12,000 raise effective immediately.

failure.outcomeText: They went with an external candidate. Disappointing.

choices.text: Say you need to think about it.
choices.outcomeText: The window closed. They picked someone else.

eventText: A distant relative you barely knew has passed away and left you something in their will.

choices.outcomeText: You feel a little guilty but the money is real.

choices.text: Donate it to charity in their name.
choices.outcomeText: It felt like the right thing to do.

eventText: Routine bloodwork comes back with results your doctor wants to discuss urgently.

failure.outcomeText: More serious than hoped. Long road ahead.

choices.outcomeText: Three months later, the situation was worse.

eventText: A friend wants you to co-found a startup with them. They have the idea; you'd handle the technical side.

choices.text: Quit your job and go all in.

success.outcomeText: Three years later, you sold the company.

failure.outcomeText: It failed after 18 months. You burned through savings.

choices.text: Work on it as a side project.
choices.outcomeText: Balancing both is exhausting, but you're managing.
You watched them build it without you.

eventText: Your partner of two years surprises you with a ring at dinner.

choices.outcomeText: You're engaged. The table next to you burst into applause.
They were hurt. The relationship is now strained.
It's over. You both knew it as soon as the word left your mouth.

eventText: The company is restructuring. Your role has been flagged in the review.

choices.text: Fight for your position — request a meeting with HR.

success.outcomeText: You made a compelling case. You keep your job.

failure.outcomeText: You were let go anyway but negotiated a better payout.
